fullContentHtml:
BSF Head Constable RO / RM Admit Card 2026 – Full Details

Border Security Force (BSF) has released the Admit Card for the Head Constable RO/RM Posts. This recruitment was released for 1121 posts. Applications for the BSF Head Constable RO/RM Recruitment 2025 were accepted from 24 August 2025 to 26 September 2025. The CBT examination is going to be conducted on 02 November 2026. Candidates who have applied for this recruitment can download their BSF Head Constable RO / RM Admit Card 2026 from the link provided below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 24 August 2025
  • Last Date : 23 September 2025
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 23 September 2025
  • Correction Date : 24-26 September 2025
  • PET/PST Admit Card : 17 December 2025
  • PET/PST Result : 25 May 2026
  • Exam Date : 02 November 2026
  • Admit Card : 21 October 2026

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 100/-
  • SC, SC : 0/-
  • All Female : 0/-

How to Check Result

  1. Click on the direct official result link provided below.
  2. Enter your Roll Number / Registration Number and Date of Birth.
  3. Submit the form to view your scorecard on screen.
  4. Download and print a copy of the result for future reference.

BSF Head Constable RO / RM Admit Card 2026 is the official result announcement. Candidates can check their scorecard and merit status via the direct link above.
